description: This Java class facilitates migration of DBUnit XML dataset files by converting them to a new schema through database operations. It recursively processes XML files in selected directories, deploying database schema and data updates via MySQL commands, and exports the updated dataset files.

classes.name: MigrateDataSet
classes.description: Main class providing file migration functionality, including database schema updates and XML dataset conversion.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point; opens a directory chooser to select folders for migration.

methods.name: doMigration
methods.description: Recursively processes directories/files to convert XML datasets.

methods.name: execMysqlCmd
methods.description: Executes MySQL commands/scripts against a temporary database during migration.
